figurative_meaning_en: A very small or negligible amount
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজে যৎকিঞ্চিৎ অর্থ দিয়ে চলবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Even a little help will be useful for me.
A tiny amount of money will suffice for this task.
history: Derived from Sanskrit 'yat kiñcit', commonly used in classical Bengali literature to denote minimal sufficiency.
note: This idiom reflects the influence of Sanskrit on Bengali vocabulary, often appearing in written or poetic contexts.
